# Acme Trust Center

Acme maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications. Current reports are available under NDA through your account contact.

## Audit logging

Administrative activity, sign-ins and permission changes are recorded in the audit log. Audit log retention is 90 days on the Business plan and 400 days on the Enterprise plan. Retention cannot currently be configured beyond those values.

## Data deletion

Customers can delete individual records through the API to satisfy a GDPR erasure request. Deletions propagate to destinations on the next sync run.
